title: Apache Hive
scope: A comprehensive Apache Hive course covering HiveQL, HiveServer2 and Beeline, the Hive Metastore, managed/external tables, partitions and bucketing, ORC/Parquet, joins and analytics, Tez execution, statistics and CBO, ACID transactions and compaction, materialized views, UDFs/SerDes/storage handlers, security, workload management, replication, Iceberg integration, performance tuning, observability, upgrades, and production data-warehouse/lake design.
coverage_note: Apache Hive 4.2.0 baseline with JDK 21, Hadoop 3.4.1 and Tez 0.10.5 compatibility, modern standalone Hive Metastore, ACID/compaction, Iceberg enhancements, catalog capabilities, security, and production operations
